messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'You have 1 unread Message!', "We're introducing our new online banking to all customers in early 2012.", 'ALL THE ORIGINAL CONTRACTORS HAS JUST RECEIVED THEIR FINAL PHASE OF THEIR PAYMENT LEAVING A TOTAL SUM OF $30 MILLION USD FLOATING IN THE FILES OF FEDERAL MINISTRY OF FINANCE UNCLAIMED', 'Your Account Will Be Limited, Until We Here From You.', 'We have implemented security measures consistent with our internal information security practices helping us keep your information secure.', 'We recently have determined that different computers have logged onto your AIB account, and multiple password failures were present before the logins.', 'Unfortunately there has been a problem processing your last transfer information for the month of August 2007.', 'your Apple ID has been locked for security reasons.', 'You have exceeded your email storage capacity.', "Until we can confirm the information you've given us, we need to limit most of the functionality on your account.", 'Our system has blocked this sign in attempt as a security measure.', 'Your Wachovia account has been selected for a free premium service upgrade at your choice, for further information please...', 'We are currently upgrading our database and e-mail account center.', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'Access Suspended: To protect your accounts, our monitoring process has temporarily suspended your online access.', 'Your access to Online Banking Service has been suspended.', 'Your incoming mail are blocked.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We provide account updates, security alerts, service changes, verification requests, and notices about payments, access restrictions, and email capacity."}
